Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the web results and concluded that 360info was the not-for-profit outlet Andrew Jaspan co-founded. The visible sources indicated that Jaspan founded/co-founded The Conversation (e.g., The Conversation’s own “About us” page and the Medianet snippet stating he is “co-founder of The Conversation”), while 360info was described as his later project. The Planner ignored this evidence and prematurely marked the task complete with the incorrect entity.
